description: REQ-BILL-021 specifies cancel link session consumption timing, listing the following pre-cancel validations that must pass before consumption: 'Origin, link session validity, existing subscription, inflight check, access_end_at, payjp_subscription_id, acceptance boundary'. However, implementation-design-mvp.md section 5.2 specifies the cancel sequence as: step 1 (Origin + link_session), step 2 (advisory lock), step 3 (existing subscription check), step 4 (inflight check), step 5-6 (access_end_at/payjp_subscription_id check), step 7 (acceptance boundary), step 8 (link session consumption). Critically, the behavioral spec REQ-BILL-021 omits 'advisory lock acquisition' from the list of pre-cancel validations, while implementation-design step 2 shows it occurs before the existing subscription check. The advisory lock must be acquired before checking member state but the REQ does not specify this ordering.

evidence.snippet: Consumption after all pre-cancel validations pass (Origin, link session validity, existing subscription, inflight check, access_end_at, payjp_subscription_id, acceptance boundary)

sourceReference.snippet:
1. Origin / __Host-link_session を検証する
2. pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(discord_user_id)) を取得する
3. active/trial/canceled の既存購読が無い場合は 409

remediation: Update REQ-BILL-021 to explicitly include advisory lock acquisition in the pre-cancel validation sequence. The complete ordered list should be: Origin validation -> link session validation -> advisory lock acquisition -> existing subscription check -> inflight check -> access_end_at check -> payjp_subscription_id check -> acceptance boundary -> link session consumption.
